title: My Son and His Wife Took My $110,000 and Evicted Me. So I Bought Their House at Auction.
description:
I gave my son and his wife $110,000 from my 403(b) to build an in-law suite, only to be served a 30-day eviction after their divorce. I sued them for joint unjust enrichment, won a $175,000 lien, and bought the house at foreclosure auction. Now I live upstairs, rent the suite to a nurse, and both exes get a monthly bill.
#FamilyBetrayal #RevengeStory #Karma
thumb_text: THEY TOOK MY $110K. I TOOK THEIR HOUSE.
pinned_comment: If your son and his wife took $110,000 from your retirement savings to build an in-law suite, then evicted you the moment their marriage ended, what would you have done? Tell me your revenge strategy, or share your own story if you've been through a similar family betrayal, in the comments below.

thumb_lines.text: THE HOUSE WENT INTO FORECLOSURE AND THEY COULDN'T STOP IT
